authoritativeAcceptanceSource.note: A bounded repository file listing did not locate a file with ZIP03_ACCEPTANCE_AND_BLOCKERS naming. This report therefore reconciles the explicitly pinned/current evidence below and must be checked against the original archive before treating the archive checklist as exhausted.

summary.P0_gameplay: Substantial bounded ordinary-flow evidence exists: all 30 campaign encounters and all 15 challenge IDs were cleared through ordinary UI across R244/R246/R253 evidence; this establishes clears, not every canonical mechanic or full quality acceptance.
summary.P1_research: Research progression is implemented and ordinary UI routes/research transactions have bounded evidence for studies 1, 2, 3, and 5. Research 4 completion remains pending in the current evidence read; R338 procedure was prepared against earlier state, while current R358 procedure is explicitly not executed.
summary.P1_long_term_economy: R346 passed a 9-case, 30-day synthetic Core cohort matrix under the earlier R098/R144/R230 profile. R355 attempted to validate the integrated R350/R352/R353 profile but both attempts closed before any XCTest; the corrected R004 test source was not actually staged. No current-profile long-term economy result can be claimed.
summary.P1_save_compatibility: R356 passed six focused Core tests for R350 work-activation receipts, legacy migration/replay, fractional remainder handling, and R350-off compatibility. This is a focused Core result, not a full app-level migration/release proof.
summary.P1_gear_progression: R350 natural gear discovery and R352 refinement/R353 dismantle code are integrated in current Core; focused tests cover contracts. An earned ordinary R358 refinement transaction is still not evidenced by the inspected procedure, which is marked PROCEDURE_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED.
summary.P1_commerce: R346 purchase-like cohorts are test-only simulated grant arms, not StoreKit transactions, adopted products/prices, or causal purchase-value evidence. Store purchase authority, receipt validation, platform configuration, and external purchase QA remain unverified.
summary.P2_final_quality: No aggregate release-quality, full accessibility/device, or Human playability acceptance is implied by these Core/UI slices. Challenge completion totals and the 15 canonical mechanic requirements are distinct.

evidence.observed: 9 cases = 3 hypothetical cohort arms × 3 seeds, each 30 virtual days; each reported 30 campaign wins and 15 challenge wins. The test cohort injects explicit test-only grants; it is not actual monetization or a free-vs-paid causal study.
evidence.limit: Earlier profile/configuration, one 30-day horizon; no 90-day outcome or current integrated R350/R352/R353 profile result.

evidence.observed: Two compile attempts, zero XCTest. The prepared package was bound to the prior test path although corrected candidate R004 existed; the root explicitly closed the batch. Do not treat this as a gameplay failure or silently convert R346 into current-profile validation.
evidence.limit: No third attempt or same-batch retry. Any later validation must be a new, explicitly scoped batch with exact candidate-to-package path and hash cross-binding.

evidence.observed: 6/6 Core methods passed against the pinned R350 engine: migration receipt settlement, no retroactive natural gear, fractional legacy remainder boundary, duplicate replay, and R350-off legacy receipt behavior.
evidence.limit: In-memory repository/Core scope; not a complete app-container recovery, UI migration, or release save-compatibility certification.

evidence.limit: The inspected artifact explicitly says not executed. A root status message reports collection progression, but no closed execution artifact was available in this read, so it is not counted as completed.
